content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, brushing my shoulder against his ||| "Let them watch while I share your secrets."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, letting the weight of his gaze settle ||| "I won't answer until you clarify what's at stake."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his eyes, vulnerability spilling out ||| "I feel cornered, and you know it."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade tighter, claiming my power back ||| "I will speak, but only on my terms."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, eyes fixed on the floor |||
